reason: A read-only narrative state ledger that verifies continuity, fact provenance, contradictions, and character knowledge, with CLI and bounded inline MCP query and verification interfaces.

summaries.zh: 用于验证故事时间线、事实断言、矛盾状态与角色知识范围的叙事状态账本。
summaries.en: A narrative state ledger for validating story continuity, fact assertions, contradictions, and character knowledge.

capabilities: Reads manifest, event, and canon source data within a configured workspace root
Validates narrative continuity, story-time ordering, fact assertions, retractions, contradictions, and character knowledge
Produces deterministic JSON reports and may write them only to an explicit artifact directory
Exposes command-line and bounded inline stdio MCP interfaces
